findings.title: Off-by-one error in `totalPages` when `user_count` is a multiple of `limit`
findings.body: `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1`. When `user_count` is an exact non-zero multiple of `limit` (for example, 50 members with the default `limit` of 50), this returns `2` instead of `1`. Because `showingLast` checks `currentPage === totalPages`, the Next button remains enabled on the last page and clicking it sets `offset` to `50` and loads an empty page `2/2`. This should be `Math.ceil(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit"))`.

findings.title: `add_members` raises `ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique` if a user is already in the group
findings.body: `add_members` calls `group.add(user)` for each username without checking whether the user is already a member of the group (e.g. `unless group.users.include?(user)`). Because `group_users` has a unique index on `(group_id, user_id)`, adding an existing member or passing duplicate usernames raises `ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique` (HTTP 500). This is especially easy to hit from the UI because `addMembers` in `admin-group.js.es6` (line 62) does not clear `this.get("usernames")` after adding members, so subsequent additions re-submit previously added usernames.

findings.title: `usernames` is never cleared after adding members or when switching groups
findings.body: In `AdminGroupController`, `usernames` is not cleared after `addMembers` runs (and is not reset in `AdminGroupRoute#setupController` when switching between groups). Any usernames entered in the selector remain bound to the singleton controller, so adding another batch of users or navigating to another group keeps the old usernames in the input.

findings.title: `Admin::GroupsController#create` ignores `alias_level`
findings.body: The new-group form in `app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/group.hbs` displays the `alias_level` combo-box and `Discourse.Group#asJSON` sends `alias_level` in the `POST /admin/groups` payload, but `Admin::GroupsController#create` only assigns `name` and `visible` (unlike `update`, which sets `group.alias_level = params[:alias_level].to_i if params[:alias_level].present?`). Any alias level selected during group creation is silently ignored and saved as the default (`0`).

findings.title: Removing the last member on a page leaves pagination stuck on an empty out-of-bounds page
findings.body: When removing the sole member on the last page (e.g. the 51st member when `limit` is 50 and `offset` is 50), `removeMember` calls `findMembers()` while `user_count` in memory is still `51`. `findMembers()` sends `offset: 50` to the server, which now has `total: 50` and returns `members: []` with `meta: { total: 50, limit: 50, offset: 50 }`. `setProperties` then sets `user_count: 50` and `offset: 50`, leaving the UI displaying an empty member list at an out-of-bounds offset instead of clamping `offset` to the last valid page.
